title: Org Membership Edge
description: A membership/relationship edge in the org graph: principal to group/org-unit, or the manager chain. Supports direct and transitive resolution so consumers can answer 'is X a (transitive) member of G' and 'who is the Nth-level manager of X'. depth=0 means a direct edge.

target_id.description: Group, org-unit, or (for manager/sponsor edges) the related principal.

transitive.description: True if the edge is derived through intermediate nodes (nested groups, manager chain).

depth.description: Hops from subject to target (0 = direct).
